metadata.title: PLTR support and resistance levels to watch

content.text:
Investing.com -- Palantir Technologies Inc (PLTR) is trading at $167.79 as of Nov 9, 2026, 10:26 AM EST. Price has rebounded from the $152.60–$154.99 area, but remains below major daily averages.
Support Below
-
$165.25–$161.05: Immediate support, based on recent lows and the daily pivot area.
-
$157.00–$153.50: Stronger support zone. It combines the daily S1 near $157.09 with the 200-day SMA at $153.52.
-
$150.00: Major psychological and structural support if $153.50 fails.
A break below $161.05 would weaken the rebound and expose the $157–$153.50 zone. Palantir Technologies Inc (PLTR) breaking below the $161.05 immediate-support level would be the first downside warning.
Resistance Above
-
$168.30–$170.20: Immediate resistance. This includes Fibonacci and classical pivot resistance.
-
$172.40–$174.40: Heavier resistance, near the daily 50-SMA at $174.40.
-
$185.50–$188.05: Major overhead supply, marked by the daily 50-SMA and 20-SMA.
-
$201–$213: Longer-term resistance, including the recent 52-week high at $212.94.
A sustained break above $174.40 would improve the short-term structure. Palantir Technologies Inc (PLTR) breaking above the $174.40 resistance zone would signal that buyers are reclaiming the middle of the recent decline.
Momentum Check
The daily technical gauge is Strong Sell, with RSI at 37.92 as of Nov 9, 2026, 10:26 AM EST. That shows weak momentum, but not yet deeply oversold. The weekly RSI is near neutral, suggesting the larger trend is less decisive.
Bull case: Holding $161–$165 and reclaiming $170 could target $174, then $185.
Bear case: Losing $161 could retest $157–$153.50, where the 200-day SMA becomes the market's stress test.
Historical data is limited to 10 years on Pro+ plan.
